title: Motion Analysis Properties
description: Detects motion events within defined zones in a video surveillance system. Captures entry and exit timestamps along with frame-level timing information. Use this event when queries involve motion detection, zone-based activity, or time-based movement tracking.

zoneID.description: Identifier of the zone where motion was detected.

exitTimeStamp.description: The timestamp when the detected object exited the defined zone. Recorded in ISO 8601 date-time format.

entryTimeStamp.description: The timestamp when the detected object entered the defined zone. Recorded in ISO 8601 date-time format.

frameEntryTimeStamp.description: The frame-level timestamp or identifier when motion was first detected within the zone.

frameExitTimeStamp.description: The frame-level timestamp or identifier when motion was last detected within the zone.
